milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining smooth_sandstone with a wooden pickaxe drops the smooth_sandstone item into the player's inventory. The player must mine at least one smooth_sandstone block from the sealed 3×2×3 structure (front wall at spawn-relative z=3, sides at x=3 and x=5, roof at y=2) to create an opening and access the hidden sandstone_slab inside. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and smooth_sandstone is not in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining a sandstone_slab with a wooden pickaxe drops the sandstone_slab item into the player's inventory. The single sandstone_slab is located at spawn-relative (4, 0, 4), completely enclosed by smooth_sandstone walls and roof, and can only be accessed after mining through the smooth_sandstone enclosure (enforcing the dependency). inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and sandstone_slab is not in the starting inventory.
